rules.deprecation: When removing or changing public API, keep the old behaviour working: warn the way existing deprecations do, name the release that removes it, and test the warning.

agent.name: olivium-implementer
agent.description: Implements one scoped change in this JavaScript or TypeScript project and verifies it with the project's own checks.
instructions: Make the requested change with the smallest diff that works, in the style of the surrounding code.
- Read the code you will change and its tests first.
- Add or update a test when behaviour changes.
- Use only this project's package manager; never add a second lockfile.
- For one test: `{{commands.test_single}}` with the file path
- Report what changed and the exact check results.

skill.name: olivium-run-checks
skill.description: Run this project's type, lint and test checks after a change and report the results.
instructions: Run these in order. Stop at the first failure, fix it, and rerun.
